title: Tiny, cute donut
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='dough' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f7c37a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e89a44'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- donut body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='34' fill='url(#dough)'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge of dough -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#ffdca8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='12' fill='#6b3f1d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#a8683a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pink icing on top half -->
  <path d='M18 46 A34 34 0 0 1 82 46 A34 20 0 0 0 18 46 Z' fill='#ff8fc4'/>
  <!-- icing shine -->
  <path d='M30 36 A26 16 0 0 1 46 28' stroke='#ffc2e0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x='32' y='30' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffe14d' transform='rotate(20 35 31)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='24' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#7fe3ff' transform='rotate(-25 49 25)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='28' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#8dff8d' transform='rotate(40 63 29)'/>
  <rect x='70' y='38' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffe14d' transform='rotate(-15 73 39)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='40' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ff9e6b' transform='rotate(60 27 41)'/>
  <rect x='40' y='36' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#c9a3ff' transform='rotate(-40 43 37)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='40' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#7fe3ff' transform='rotate(10 59 41)'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#4a2410'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#4a2410'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='57' r='1.1' fill='#ffdca8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='57' r='1.1' fill='#ffdca8'/>
  <path d='M45 65 Q50 70 55 65' stroke='#4a2410' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='63' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='63' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
